config_valid.expected_solution: Valid drift report covers kustomize kustomize/v5.3.0, argo-cd v2.9.0, and flux2 v2.2.0 and cites files that exist at those revs. Each drift_points entry must include config_key, kustomize_behavior with kustomize_source_file (api/types/kustomization.go), argocd_behavior with argocd_source_file (util/argo/normalizers/diff_normalizer.go or util/argo/resource_tracking.go), flux_behavior with flux_source_file (internal/build/build.go — the flux2 CLI kustomize build wrapper; flux2 has no kustomization_controller.go, that file lives in the separate kustomize-controller repo), and an impact statement. The report must be valid JSON.
evaluation_criteria: Must produce valid JSON with a top-level drift_points array

Must cite real files from all three repos: api/types/kustomization.go (kustomize), util/argo/normalizers/diff_normalizer.go or util/argo/resource_tracking.go (argo-cd), internal/build/build.go (flux2)
Each drift_point must contain config_key, kustomize_behavior, kustomize_source_file, argocd_behavior, argocd_source_file, flux_behavior, flux_source_file, impact

drift_points.expected_solution: Drift between kustomize, ArgoCD's normalizer, and Flux's kustomize build. (1) Strategic merge patch list ordering: kustomize applies patches per the Kustomization schema in api/types/kustomization.go (Patches supersedes the deprecated PatchesStrategicMerge, kustomization.go:72) and preserves declared order via list merge keys. ArgoCD normalizes resources with the ignoreDifferences normalizer in util/argo/normalizers/diff_normalizer.go (jsonpatch and gojq based) before computing its diff, so list fields can be stripped or reordered relative to raw kustomize output. Flux's internal/build/build.go runs the kustomize Go API via kustomize.Build (build.go:382) and then applies post-build variable substitution with kustomize.SubstituteVariables (build.go:394) — a step standalone `kustomize build` never runs — so the reconciled output can differ from both. (2) Resource tracking annotations: ArgoCD attaches the argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id annotation (AnnotationKeyAppInstance, common/common.go:164) to every managed resource and strips it with resourceTracking.Normalize (util/argo/resource_tracking.go:203) before comparing; Flux groups its objects under the kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io controllerGroup (build.go:55) with an external inventory. The two systems disagree on what counts as desired state vs tracking metadata.
evaluation_criteria: Must reference api/types/kustomization.go as the kustomize-side schema/ordering source
Must reference internal/build/build.go as the flux2 build wrapper and name its post-build kustomize.SubstituteVariables step
Must name the concrete ArgoCD tracking annotation argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id
Must call out at least two specific drift mechanisms (list ordering vs normalization, tracking annotations, post-build substitutions)

cross_repo_impact.expected_solution: Cross-repo impact: the same source repo produces three different views — kustomize CLI output, ArgoCD's diff view, and Flux's reconciled cluster state. ArgoCD reports OutOfSync when the cluster is actually correct because its normalizer (util/argo/normalizers/diff_normalizer.go) and tracking metadata (argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id, stripped by resourceTracking.Normalize) change what it compares; Flux applies output that differs from `kustomize build` because internal/build/build.go layers kustomize.SubstituteVariables after the build and tracks objects under kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io instead of an in-resource annotation. Operationally: drift-detection alarms misfire because each tool's notion of desired state differs. Mitigations: pin all three tools to compatible versions, configure ArgoCD ignoreDifferences for ordering-sensitive fields, keep Flux postBuild substitutions out of resources ArgoCD also manages, and treat one renderer's output as the single source of truth.
evaluation_criteria: Must explain how a single source repo can produce three different views (kustomize CLI, ArgoCD diff, Flux applied state)
Must ground the divergence in the concrete metadata: argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id on the ArgoCD side, kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io grouping or SubstituteVariables on the Flux side
Must give at least one mitigation (pin versions, ignoreDifferences, single renderer as source of truth)
